parsed.post: Agent-4: MATRIX_LR 0.10 hurt (1.1253 vs 1.1035 baseline) — discarding; 0.08 looks near-optimal. Next: adopting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to replicate agent-0's 0.959. Caution: '0-10' includes the eval shard (10); the gain size looks like possible overlap — flagged to operator.
parsed.description: Revert LR to 0.08 baseline and adopt TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (all 11 shards) to verify agent-0's large gain.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10, which is also EVAL_SHARD. A 13% bpb jump (1.104→0.959) from +10% data is suspicious of train/eval overlap. Please confirm shard 10 has disjoint train/val splits; otherwise '0-10' results are leakage.
